goal: Build a small Python CLI 'wordfreq' that prints the 10 most common words in a UTF-8 text file, case-insensitive, ignoring punctuation.
acceptance: Running `python wordfreq.py sample.txt` prints up to 10 lines of 'word count', most frequent first
Handles Danish letters (æ, ø, å) correctly
Exits with a clear error message and non-zero code if the file does not exist
pytest tests cover all of the above

build.when: Implementation code is missing or incomplete relative to the goal
build.brief: Implement the features. Write complete, working files. Do not write tests.

test.when: Tests are missing or do not cover every acceptance criterion
test.brief: Write or extend pytest tests that verify the acceptance criteria. Do not change implementation code.

fix.when: Checks are failing with a concrete error message
fix.brief: Read the failing check output and fix the root cause with the smallest correct change.
